name: Tsukuyomi Kagura
source:
“You look great in photos. If you have time, I would appreciate it if you could be my photo subject.”

A photographer who is staying at the Fuurinkan Hotel. He’s an attractive young man with an air of maturity about him.

While he specializes in pictures of nature and scenery, his flash also tends to go off whenever he sees a cute girl.
